topic.label: Geophysics
topic.desc: Geophysics: the physics of the solid Earth, measured through seismic, gravity, magnetic, electrical and geodetic methods.

concepts: Elastic waves generated by earthquakes and controlled sources, used to locate events and image the Earth's interior.
Reflection and refraction seismic methods for imaging subsurface structure for resources, engineering and hazards.
Measuring and modelling variations in gravity and magnetic fields to detect density and magnetisation contrasts.
Earth's shape, rotation and deformation measured by satellite geodesy, and the mantle dynamics behind plate tectonics.
Resistivity, induced polarisation, electromagnetic and ground-penetrating radar methods for near-surface investigation.
Inverse theory, regularisation and the spatial data and literature that support geophysical interpretation.
skills: Locates an earthquake from P and S arrival times at several stations and checks the solution by travel-time residuals.
Computes local and moment magnitude from amplitudes or seismic moment and checks consistency between scales.
Infers fault orientation and slip type from first-motion polarities and checks the nodal planes against regional tectonics.
Derives layer velocities and depths from a refraction travel-time plot and checks crossover distances against the model.
Designs a processing sequence of deconvolution, velocity analysis, stack and migration and checks each step's input and output.
Builds reflection coefficients from impedance logs and convolves with a wavelet, checking the result in Wolfram against observed traces.
Applies latitude, free-air, Bouguer and terrain corrections to gravity readings and checks corrected values by recomputing a sample station.
Computes the gravity or magnetic anomaly of a buried body and checks the formula and result in Wolfram.
Interprets magnetic anomalies with reduction to the pole and derivatives and checks interpreted bodies against geology.
Estimates station velocities from GNSS time series and checks for outliers and reference frame consistency.
Computes Airy or Pratt compensation depths for a topographic load and checks the result with a mass balance.
Computes relative plate velocity from an Euler pole and checks speed and direction at a test point in Wolfram.
Inverts a vertical electrical sounding curve into layer resistivities and checks fit error against the data.
Converts radar travel times to depth with an estimated velocity and checks reflector depths against ground truth.
Chooses frequency range and station spacing to reach a target depth by skin depth and checks the calculation.
Sets up and solves a damped least-squares inverse problem and checks resolution and misfit against the noise level.
Maps station locations and gridded geophysical data in GIS Cloud and checks coordinates and projection.
Finds geophysics preprints through alphaXiv and checks each summarised result against the paper.
mcp: Inject precise, real-time computation and knowledge
Fast search and full-text access over arXiv pre-prints
Run your entire GIS workflow in plain language: maps, data, analysis, field apps, and reports
